screen_type: Responsive research dashboard - code audit before improvements
audited: UX Analyzer: application shell, Overview, Sessions, calibration/recording flow, session details. Source-code review supported by the earlier screenshots in chat; no new rendered desktop/phone captures were available.
summary: The original interface already has recognizable routes and useful session metrics. Small controls, weak status colours and a crowded phone header reduce usability. This score describes the original code, not a visual certification of the updated app. The fixes listed below have now been implemented; browser-based layout and assistive-technology verification remain outstanding.

categories.note: Original white-on-blue button text measured 4.02:1; updated teal measures 5.47:1.
Original bright hero and multiple coloured tiles compete; updated page has one primary action and neutral metric cards.
Content edges are consistent, but the original header has no phone reflow.
Original body/helper copy is often 12-14px, including at phone widths.
Original small buttons and icon-only tabs fall short of comfortable phone targets.
Shared components help, but logo navigation, keyboard focus and completion states need work.

issues.title: Small button text and status colours need stronger contrast
issues.element: index.css primary colour; ui.jsx Button, Badge and StatTile
issues.problem: White on the original #007AFF is 4.02:1, below the 4.5:1 target for ordinary button text. Bright green/orange status colours are also used for small labels and large values on pale surfaces.
issues.why: C1-C3 require readable text and meaningful graphics. Exact primary-button contrast was measured with the bundled Stroom script.
issues.fix: Implemented #0F766E primary (5.47:1 on white), #596579 helper text (5.90:1), dark status badge text and neutral metric values. The remaining chart/recording overlay colours still need a dedicated visual contrast review.

issues.title: The dashboard has too many competing accents
issues.element: DashboardPage.jsx hero, metrics and quick-action cards
issues.problem: A saturated blue banner, coloured metrics, badges and coloured workflow cards all seek attention.
issues.why: H2 and H4 ask for importance to drive emphasis, with a small number of competing levels.
issues.fix: Implemented a quiet introductory hero, one primary Start a session action, secondary Explore sessions, neutral statistic cards and numbered workflow cards.

issues.title: The header does not adapt to narrow phones
issues.problem: The wordmark, four full navigation labels and live status share a row without wrapping or a mobile alternative.
issues.why: S4 requires usable margins without crowding. P4 asks for actions that remain easy to reach on phones.
issues.fix: Implemented desktop sidebar, compact top bar, phone bottom navigation and consistent 16px phone content margins. The logo is now a home link, addressing K3 too. Rendered phone-width verification is still needed.

issues.title: Important reading text is too small or too wide
issues.element: ui.jsx Alert and helper copy throughout the pages
issues.problem: Body paragraphs often use text-sm (14px), with text-xs instructions at phone widths. Original alerts do not limit paragraph width.
issues.why: T1 recommends about 16px web body copy. T3 recommends a comfortable paragraph measure.
issues.fix: Implemented 16px body copy, at least 12px helper copy (13px on phones), clear page titles and a max-prose width for alerts.

issues.title: Touch targets and mobile tabs are cramped
issues.element: ui.jsx small buttons; SessionDetailPage.jsx tabs and back button; checkbox labels
issues.problem: Original small controls can be around 28px tall, the back control is 32px wide, and phone tab labels disappear. Native checkbox hit areas are small without a padded label.
issues.why: P1-P3 call for comfortable targets, a 24px floor and separation between adjacent controls.
issues.fix: Implemented minimum 44px buttons, 48px standard actions, labelled scrollable tabs with 8px gaps and 44px checkbox labels. The back button is widened to 44px. Native media controls remain browser-managed.

issues.title: Keyboard focus is explicitly suppressed
issues.element: ui.jsx Button inline outline:none; application navigation
issues.problem: Removing the default outline without replacing it leaves keyboard users without a reliable focus marker.
issues.why: K4 requires visibly distinct focus states; C3 also applies to the focus indicator.
issues.fix: Removed outline suppression, added a 3px teal focus-visible ring with 4px offset, added a skip link and respected reduced-motion preferences.

issues.title: Session identifiers obscure the useful information
issues.element: DashboardPage.jsx SessionRow and ResultsPage.jsx session cards
issues.problem: Long generated IDs are the main title, while the date is secondary. A session with zero gaze samples can look as complete as a session with valid eye tracking.
issues.why: H2 and K4 require important information and missing-data states to be recognizable.
issues.fix: Implemented date-first session titles, searchable date/ID, secondary ID metadata and an explicit No gaze data badge. Existing quality warnings and screenshot heatmaps are retained.

issues.title: Calibration and saving need clearer handoffs
issues.problem: The calibration preview text says Enter begins recording although the calibration route only saves a model. Recording can show success before camera readiness or before saving finishes.
issues.why: K4 requires accurate progress and completion feedback next to the action.
issues.fix: Implemented save-calibration instructions, explicit success and Continue to recording, camera-readiness copy, pending request indicators and a saving state that prevents repeated Stop requests. These flows still need a real camera/browser acceptance test.

strengths.title: Recognizable workflow
strengths.detail: Calibrate, Record and Sessions already express the main research tasks.

strengths.title: Reusable UI components
strengths.detail: Shared buttons, cards, alerts and badges allow improvements to reach every page consistently.

strengths.title: Useful evidence alongside analysis
strengths.detail: Session details retain screen playback, screenshot heatmaps, gaze quality and friction events.

checklist.note: Original primary button is 4.02:1; addressed with 5.47:1 teal.
Bright status colours are used for original large metric values on pale surfaces; updated metrics use dark ink.
Some original status/graphic colours are too light. Shared controls improved; chart colours still require visual review.

checklist.rule: Colour is not the only signal
checklist.note: Status and friction badges have labels, not colour alone.
Operational text is outside screenshot backgrounds.
The original hero has one high-emphasis white Record button; no invented failure here.

checklist.rule: Most important thing stands out most
checklist.note: Original IDs and coloured tiles distract from useful dates and session completeness.
Pages already use h1 and section headings.
Original hero, metric colours and action cards compete. Neutral surfaces now reduce this.
Tailwind spacing tokens give the original layout a repeatable base.

checklist.rule: Labels sit closest to their own field
checklist.note: The original audited pages contain few editable fields; no rendered field grouping was available.
Main content uses shared containers and grids.

checklist.rule: Consistent outer margins and breathing room
checklist.note: Original header has no narrow-screen reflow; replaced with separate desktop/phone navigation.
Original 12-14px copy persists on phones; updated body text is 16px.

checklist.rule: Clear type scale with few typefaces
checklist.note: One system-font family and a small set of Tailwind sizes.
Original full-width alerts can run long; updated alerts use max-prose.
Body copy is predominantly left aligned with comfortable leading.
Original small buttons and back control are undersized; minimums raised.
Original native checkbox hit areas are small; updated labels have 44px hit height.
Original segmented tabs have 4px gaps; updated gaps are 8px.

checklist.rule: Key actions are easy to reach
checklist.note: Original navigation is only at the top; phone bottom navigation added.
Original shared components are a strong base; updated radii and heights are centralized.
Start Calibration, Start Recording and Download PNG are task-specific labels.
Original wordmark was not a home link; now uses a labelled Link.
Original suppressed focus and ambiguous completion states were corrected. Full browser/assistive-tech verification remains outstanding.
